content: If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store the medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations or pharmacy guidelines. This information was last updated in August 2024. While taking this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and/or medical tests, such as liver function tests, viral load assessments, and T-cell counts, as recommended by your healthcare provider.
